sentences.text: PMMSY: Ice Plant/Cold Store of Minimum 30-Ton Capacity - Haryana

**Scheme Brief Description:** The subsidy for 30-ton capacity ice plants/cold storage units under Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY) supports the establishment of ice plants or cold storage facilities with a minimum capacity of 30 tons to improve fish preservation and cold chain infrastructure in Haryana.
**Who is this for:** Business Entity, Individual; Category: Agriculture,Rural & Environment; Sector: Fishing and hunting

**Detailed Description:** The Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana: Ice Plant/Cold Store of minimum 30-ton capacity, introduced by the Ministry Of Fisheries, Animal Husbandry & Dairying, Government of India, aims to provide the subsidy to support the establishment of ice plants or cold storage facilities with a minimum capacity of 30 tons to strengthen fish preservation and cold chain infrastructure in Haryana. This centrally sponsored scheme is jointly funded 50% by the Central Government and 50% by the State Government. Beneficiaries must submit an undertaking in their DPR/SCP to keep the unit operational, bear all post-construction costs, and ensure ice is supplied to fishers and fish farmers at affordable prices.

**Benefits / Assistance:** - The project cost is ₹120,00,000/- > **Subsidy Distribution :** 1. A 40% subsidy is available for the General Category. 1. A 60% subsidy is offered for SC (Scheduled Caste) and Women beneficiaries.

**Application Process:** > **Registration Process on Antyodaya-SARAL Portal:** **Step 1:** Visit the Official Portal: [Antyodaya-SARAL Portal.](https://saralharyana.gov.in/) **Step 2:** For registration, click on “New User/Register Here” and fill in all the mandatory details i.e. Name, Email ID, Mobile Number &amp; password. Click on ‘Submit’. **Step 3:** Verify the OTP received in the provided Email and Mobile Number. Alternatively, click on the Verification Link to activate the profile. > **Login to Apply for the Scheme:** **Step 1:** Visit the Official Portal: [Antyodaya-SARAL Portal.](https://saralharyana.gov.in/) **Step 2:** The “Sign in here” option is available on the right side of the screen. Fill in the required credentials and click on the ‘Login’ button. **Step 3:** In the opened window, click on “Scheme/Services list”, and a list of schemes will appear on the screen. **Step 4:** Now, select the scheme and click on “Apply for Service/Scheme”. **Step 5:** Fill in all the details in the online application form and click on &quot;Submit&quot;. <br> > **Track Your Service Online:** - **Track Application/Appeal:** [Click here](https://status.saralharyana.nic.in/). - **Track Ticket:** [Click here](https://eticketing.saralharyana.nic.in/CitizenViewComplaints.aspx). <br> > **Track Your Service Through SMS:** - **Registered Mobile Number:** Type SARAL and send to 9954699899 to track your application. - **Other Mobile Number:** Type SARAL&lt;space&gt;&lt;Application ID/Ticket No.&gt; and send to 9954699899 to track your application/ticket. <br> > **Contact Us:** - **Helpline:** 0172-3968400 - **Email:** saral.haryana@gov.in <br> > **Note:** - **Govt. Charges:** No Fee - **Service Charges:** ₹10/- - **Atal Seva Kendra Service Charges:** ₹10/-
**Additional Application Processes:** **Process 2:** The eligible applicant may visit the nearest Atal Seva Kendra with all the required documents to apply for the scheme.
**Tags:** Entrepreneurs, Fish Farmers, Cold Chain Infrastructure, Fish Preservation
